apiCalls: PreviewModel.getProperties().putValue(PreviewProperty.SHOW_NODE_LABELS, true)  (every other preview property: Gephi's default, unless previewProperties sets it)

canvas.requested: 1200 x 900 px is not available: Gephi's SVG render target sizes the canvas to the drawing's own bounds, and SVGExporter has no canvas setting (only margin and scaleStrokes)

fonts: Gephi writes font-family="Dialog" (Java's logical font); rasterize.mjs draws it with the repository's pinned fonts
svgPostprocessing: 1 label text(s) put back to the label Gephi draws (restoreLabelText): Gephi's SVG writer drops the space before an entity reference ("a & b <c>" is written "a& b<c>") and a line break, where its Preview, its PNG export and its preview items keep the space and draw the break as nothing; nothing else changed
